text:
Experimental, and planned before the trees are chosen.

Higher still is possible, and it is experimental. It depends on the trees, and it has to be planned before they are chosen; the owner's are not set up for it. Strung at 12 metres, the same pull is half again the lever: unguyed, the trunks would be worked to a margin of 1.0, at the edge of breaking, and the guys pull 46 kilonewtons. Here is how it would go, if the trees allowed it.
